Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever visits India, meets PM Modi

Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever visited India and met with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. During his visit, De Wever paid tribute to Mahatma Gandhi at Rajghat. Discussions between the two leaders covered various issues, including trade and defense cooperation between India and Belgium. The visit aimed to strengthen bilateral relations.
